concerns.text: SC-005 requires validating that at least 3 of 15 independent ABA-signaling genes appear in the top 10 ranks. Task T029 handles the synthetic case by reporting 'Validation against real genes skipped... SC-005 invalidated' but provides no task to actually perform the verification logic (counting overlap) when real data IS available. The spec requires the system to perform this check; the task only handles the failure mode.

FR-002 mandates 'phylogenetic MICE' for missing continuous traits. Task T014a implements a fallback to 'Median Substitution' if a tree is missing. While T014b implements Phylogenetic MICE, T014a's logic explicitly prioritizes the fallback if the tree check fails (which the Plan admits is likely). There is no task guaranteeing the implementation of Phylogenetic MICE as the primary path if a tree becomes available, only a conditional fallback path.

FR-001 requires downloading genomic annotation files from NCBI RefSeq. Task T011b attempts this but immediately falls back to synthetic data if the fetch fails (in Validation Mode) or raises an error (in Production Mode). There is no task that successfully implements the download and parsing of real NCBI RefSeq data for the specified species list, as the Plan explicitly substitutes synthetic data due to 'absence of verified plant genomic data sources'. The requirement to download real data is unfulfilled by any task.

FR-009 requires a KNN baseline using a 'phylogenetic distance matrix'. Task T021 defaults to a synthetic random matrix (T016a) if a real tree is missing. The Spec does not authorize a random matrix as a valid proxy. There is no task that successfully implements the baseline using a real phylogenetic distance matrix, as the Plan admits no verified tree exists.

Task T041 appears twice: once in Phase 2 (Foundational) as 'Create code/run_pipeline.py' and again in Phase 7 (Revision) as a reference note. The Phase 7 entry is redundant and confusing, stating 'Task T041... was consolidated' but retaining the ID. This creates a stale/duplicate tag situation.
